blockingFindings.description: Direct V13 inspection of crouch and sit, compared side by side with the V12 captures: the wider Hips-anchored medial weight band does not produce a visible closure of the inner-thigh/hip-crease gap. Shorts coverage and pose fit remain rejected; no improvement is claimed.
Current back, crouch and sit renders still show an angular raised rear block and narrow pointed cloth tails under the seat. Silhouette and pose deformation remain rejected.

Current front, side, arms-up and arm-cross renders still show triangular facet highlights across sleeves, shoulders, side torso and waist. Smooth shading remains ineffective; mesh surface quality is rejected.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
